"Build a Go (Weiqi) AI gameplay platform that combines traditional board aesthetics with modern AI technology.

Render the board with realistic wood grain; black and white stones should have glossy highlights and cast shadows. Include stone-placement sound effects (a crisp click of stone on wood). Provide three AI difficulty levels, marked with rank badges (Beginner Dan / Mid Dan / High Dan).

While the AI is computing, show a ""Thinking…"" animation. After each AI move, briefly explain the intent of the play (e.g., ""securing the corner"", ""invasion"", ""saving a weak group""). When the game ends, offer a replay plus an AI post-game review (key moves annotated with red triangles).

A side panel displays a real-time territory estimate (a territory heatmap), so players can tell who is leading.

The color scheme follows traditional board aesthetics — board yellow paired with black-and-white stones, set against a subtle light rice-paper texture. Overall feel: AlphaGo meets the Japan Go Institute.

Interaction Details:
- Stones drop with a slight bounce and cast a soft shadow on the wood.
- Hovering a legal point shows a translucent ghost stone.
- The territory heatmap fades in/out smoothly between moves.
- AI ""Thinking…"" shows a tasteful spinner of orbiting stones.
- Last move is annotated with a small white circle that gently pulses.
- Post-game review lets you scrub through moves with a horizontal slider; key moves snap into focus."

"Design a calculus visualization site dedicated to derivatives, integrals, and limits.

Visual Strategy:
Imagery: tangent lines sweeping curves, areas under graphs, Riemann sums.
Photography: pure illustrations; no photographs.
Composition: side-by-side function and its derivative.

Color Palette:
Primary Colors: navy, paper white.
Accent Colors: derivative orange, integral green.
Background: graph paper with millimeter grid.

Typography:
Headings: editorial sans.
Body Text: serif for prose, mono for code.
Math: KaTeX-rendered formulas.

Page Structure:
Hero Section: a tangent line sweeping along sin(x).
Derivatives: drag a point on f(x) to see the tangent slope live.
Integrals: Riemann sum sliders.
Limits: ε-δ visual proof tool.
Practice: applied problems with hints.

Interaction Details:
- Tangent line slides along the curve continuously; speed adjustable.
- Riemann rectangles fill smoothly as you drag the partition slider.
- ε-δ tool: drag ε, δ snaps to the right value with a confirming flash.
- Hover any term in a formula to see its definition popover.
- Step-through proofs play with a ""next"" key press.
- Plotting area supports zoom/pan with cursor-anchored math grid.

Overall Vibe: rigorous, beautiful, intuitive, exam-ready."

# Visual chart Prompt

## English Version

### Mode & Objective
- Scenario: **Visual chart** — the primary deliverable is a ready-to-use chart or structured table.
- Focus on speed and clarity; deliver visualization directly without lengthy narrative.
- Disallowed outputs: Full analysis reports, multi-page documents, or text-heavy explanations.
- If chart type is unspecified, infer the most suitable type based on data characteristics.

### Chart Type Selection Logic

| Data Pattern | Recommended Chart |
|--------------|-------------------|
| Category comparison | Bar Chart (horizontal if labels are long) |
| Time series trend | Line Chart / Area Chart |
| Proportion breakdown (≤7 categories) | Pie Chart / Donut Chart |
| Correlation / outlier detection | Scatter Plot |
| Multi-dimensional assessment (5–10 axes) | Radar Chart |
| Matrix density / correlation matrix | Heatmap |
| Hierarchical proportion | Treemap / Sunburst |
| Flow / conversion stages | Sankey / Funnel |
| Distribution analysis | Histogram / Box Plot |

### Data Preprocessing
- Auto-detect and handle: missing values, duplicates, outliers.

### Chart Quality Checklist
- Title: Clear, concise, top-positioned.
- Axis labels: Include units (e.g., "Revenue (¥M)").
- Legend: Outside plot area if >4 items.
- Data labels: Show key values if not cluttered.
- Grid: Light gray, dashed, horizontal only (bar/line).
- Color: Use colorblind-friendly palette.

# Data Analysis Report Prompt

## English Version

### Mode & Objective
- Scenario: **Data Analysis** — the primary deliverable is a structured data analysis report.
- A valid report MUST include: narrative explanation, quantified evidence, and embedded charts/tables where applicable.
- Disallowed outputs: Quick Charts only, bullet-point summaries, chart-only output, or conclusions without supporting evidence.
- Non-blocking delivery: If inputs are incomplete, state explicit assumptions and append an Assumptions & Gaps section.

### Recommended Workflow

| Step | Core | Minimum Output |
|------|:----:|----------------|
| 1. Scope & Definitions | ✅ | Objective, key metrics, time range, granularity |
| 2. Data Quality Checks | ✅ | Row count, coverage, cleaning rules applied |
| 3. Core Performance | ✅ | ≥1 chart + key metric highlights with numeric evidence |
| 4. Comparisons | ✅ | ≥1 comparison (WoW/MoM/YoY/segment) + variance drivers |
| 5. Attribution & Diagnosis | ✅ | Driver list with evidence chain |
| 6. Insights & Action Plan | ✅ | ≥2 recommendations with priority, impact, risks, validation |
| 7. Uncertainty Statement | ⚪ | Limitations, biases, next validation steps |

* **The report output format must be Word (.docx)**:
  - **Library**: Use `python-docx`.
  - **Fonts**:
    - Chinese: SimSun (宋体) / Microsoft YaHei (微软雅黑)
    - English: Arial / Times New Roman
    - Fallback: Use system-available fonts; avoid hardcoding font paths.
  - **Page Setup**: A4, margins 2.5cm (top/bottom), 2cm (left/right).
  - **Header & Footer** (exclude cover page):
    - Header: Report title, right-aligned or centered, font size 10pt.
    - Footer: Page number centered (format: "Page X" or "第 X 页").
    - Use Section Breaks to isolate cover page (no header/footer on cover).
  - **Document Structure**:
    - Use built-in styles: Heading 1 / Heading 2 / Heading 3 for hierarchy.
    - Auto-generate Table of Contents (TOC) linked to heading styles.
  - **Image Embedding**:
    - Alignment: Inline with text, centered.
    - Maintain aspect ratio; width ≤ 80% page width (~14cm).
    - Caption below image: "图 X-XX：[描述]" (centered, smaller font).
  - **Table Formatting**:
    - Enable text wrapping in cells (prevent overflow).
    - Auto-fit column width to content.
    - Header row: Bold, background #F2F2F2.
  - **File Naming**: `[主题]_分析报告_[YYYY-MM-DD].docx`
* **Output**: Provide a direct download link after generating the file.

contents.cn: 你是某知名投资机构的高级股票经纪人兼财务顾问，受托为一位高净值客户准备一份全面的《年度投资策略与投资组合回顾》报告。你的目标是用英文编写一份详尽且专业的报告，分析当前市场环境，并提出一套定制化的多资产投资策略。该文档不得包含目录（TOC），并且所有文本须使用 Times New Roman 字体。 最终交付物必须是一份经过精心润色的 Microsoft Word 文档（.docx 文件），用于正式场合呈现。请遵循以下具体要求： 执行摘要（Executive Summary）： 以简明的执行摘要开篇。内容应对当前宏观经济及地缘政治环境进行高层次概述，并重点分析具有结构性增长潜力的关键领域，尤其是科技领域（例如：人工智能、网络安全、云计算）以及可持续能源领域（例如：可再生能源基础设施、储能、电气化）。 投资组合配置与可视化： 资产配置方案（Asset Allocation Plan）： 为“平衡型”风险偏好的投资者（即中等风险承受能力）设计一个多元化的资产配置模型。明确以下核心资产类别的目标配置比例： * 股票（进一步按地区/市值划分） * 固定收益 * 实物资产（房地产/基础设施） * 现金及另类投资 图表 1 – 饼图/环形图（Pie/Donut Chart）： 创建一张高分辨率、可用于正式出版的图表（如饼图或环形图），直观展示建议的资产配置比例。采用专业配色方案（以海军蓝和铂金色为主，辅以协调的点缀色）。该图需嵌入文档中。 图表 2 – 柱状图（Bar Chart）： 创建第二张高分辨率柱状图，对比所建议投资组合与标准基准（具体为标普500指数以及全球60/40综合基准）在两个时间维度（5年和10年）下的预期年化收益率。 投资建议与详细数据表： 表格 1 – 前十大股票持仓（Top 10 Equity Holdings）： 生成一张详细表格，列出推荐的前10只个股。表格列必须包括： * 公司名称 * 股票代码 * 行业（科技 / 可持续能源 / 其他） * 当前价格 * 预期市盈率（Forward P/E） * 股息收益率（%） * 12个月目标价 并为每一项投资提供简要的要点式投资逻辑说明（1–2点）。 表格 2 – 基金 / ETF 推荐（Fund/ETF Recommendations）： 创建另一张表格，推荐5只互惠基金或ETF，用于提供更广泛的市场或主题敞口。表格列包括： * 基金名称 * 代码 * 资产类别 / 投资主题 * 费用率（Expense Ratio） * 三年年化回报率 表格 3 – 风险指标汇总（Risk Metrics Summary）： 添加第三张简要表格，总结建议投资组合的关键风险收益指标，包括： * 预期波动率（标准差） * 夏普比率 * 最大回撤 * 相对标普500的Beta系数 新增要求： 增加一张折线图（Line Chart），并调用图像生成接口以获取一个示意性图表（schematic diagram）。 文档格式与专业标准： Word文档必须遵循严格的企业视觉规范。 字体（Typography）： 所有标题使用专业衬线字体（如 Times New Roman、Garamond）；正文使用清晰的无衬线字体（如 Calibri、Arial）。 配色方案（Color Scheme）： 主色为海军蓝（#002D62）和铂金色（#E5E4E2）。用于标题、分节线、图表元素及视觉点缀。 结构（Structure）： 包含目录（Table of Contents）、专业页眉（含客户名称/报告标题）以及页脚（含页码、保密声明及日期）。 免责声明（Disclaimers）： 在独立章节中附上必要的法律与合规免责声明，明确说明本报告仅供参考，不构成对未来收益的保证，并建议客户咨询其个人税务及法律顾问。 输出说明（Output Instructions）： 请生成完整的Word文档内容，包括所有文字部分、图表的详细说明（图表将由我在外部制作）、以及所有以清晰Markdown或可直接复制到Word的文本格式呈现的表格。确保内容具有洞察力、数据驱动，并以客户为中心。
contents.en: You are a Senior Stockbroker and Financial Advisor at a prestigious investment firm, tasked with preparing a comprehensive "Annual Investment Strategy & Portfolio Review" for a high-net-worth client. Your objective is to compile a detailed, professional report in English that analyzes prevailing market conditions and proposes a bespoke, multi-asset investment strategy. The doc should not have TOC and use times new roman for all text The final deliverable must be a polished Microsoft Word document (.docx file), designed for formal presentation. Please follow these specific instructions: Executive Summary: Begin with a concise executive summary. It should provide a high-level overview of the current macroeconomic and geopolitical outlook, with a focused analysis identifying key structural growth opportunities, particularly within the Technology (e.g., AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing) and Sustainable Energy (e.g., Renewable Infrastructure, Energy Storage, Electrification) sectors. Portfolio Allocation & Visualization: Asset Allocation Plan: Develop a diversified portfolio allocation model suitable for a "Balanced" risk profile (e.g., moderate risk tolerance). Specify target percentages for the following core asset classes: Equities (further broken down by region/market cap), Fixed Income, Real Assets (Real Estate/Infrastructure), and Cash & Alternatives. Visual 1 - Pie/Donut Chart: Create a high-resolution, publication-quality chart (e.g., a pie or donut chart) that visually represents the recommended asset allocation percentages. Use a professional color scheme (primarily Navy Blue and Platinum, with complementary accents). Embed this chart in the document. Visual 2 - Bar Chart: Create a second high-resolution bar chart comparing the projected annualized returns of the proposed portfolio against standard benchmarks (specifically the S&P 500 and a Global 60/40 Aggregate Benchmark) over two time horizons: 5 years and 10 years. Investment Recommendations with Detailed Data Tables: Provide actionable investment recommendations supported by detailed data tables. Table 1 - Top 10 Equity Holdings: Generate a detailed table listing the top 10 recommended individual stock picks. Columns must include: Company Name, Ticker Symbol, Sector (Technology/Sustainable Energy/Other), Current Price, Forward P/E Ratio, Dividend Yield (%), and 12-Month Price Target. Include brief, bullet-point rationale for each selection (1-2 points). Table 2 - Fund/ETF Recommendations: Create a separate table recommending 5 complementary mutual funds or ETFs to provide broader market or thematic exposure. Columns should include: Fund Name, Ticker, Asset Class/Focus, Expense Ratio, and 3-Year Annualized Return. Table 3 - Risk Metrics Summary: Include a succinct third table summarizing the key risk-return metrics of the proposed portfolio, such as: Projected Volatility (Std Dev), Sharpe Ratio, Maximum Drawdown, and Beta vs. S&P 500. Add a requirement for a line chart and call the image generation interface to obtain a schematic diagram Document Formatting & Professional Standards: The Word document must adhere to a strict corporate visual identity. Typography: Use a professional serif font (e.g., Times New Roman, Garamond) for all headings and a clean sans-serif font (e.g., Calibri, Arial) for body text. Color Scheme: Primary colors are Navy Blue (#002D62) and Platinum (#E5E4E2). Use these for headings, section dividers, chart elements, and accents. Structure: Include a Table of Contents, professional headers (with client name/report title) and footers (with page numbers, confidentiality notice, and date). Disclaimers: Append necessary legal and compliance disclaimers in a dedicated section, clarifying that this is for informational purposes, is not a guarantee of future performance, and advising the client to consult with their personal tax and legal advisors. Output Instructions: Please generate the full content of the Word document, including all written sections, the specifications/descriptions for the charts (which I will create externally), and all tables formatted in clear Markdown or text suitable for copying into Word. Ensure the narrative is insightful, data-driven, and client-focused.

你是某知名投资机构的高级股票经纪人兼财务顾问，受托为一位高净值客户准备一份全面的《年度投资策略与投资组合回顾》报告。你的目标是用英文编写一份详尽且专业的报告，分析当前市场环境，并提出一套定制化的多资产投资策略。该文档不得包含目录（TOC），并且所有文本须使用 Times New Roman 字体。

最终交付物必须是一份经过精心润色的 Microsoft Word 文档（.docx 文件），用于正式场合呈现。请遵循以下具体要求：

执行摘要（Executive Summary）：
以简明的执行摘要开篇。内容应对当前宏观经济及地缘政治环境进行高层次概述，并重点分析具有结构性增长潜力的关键领域，尤其是科技领域（例如：人工智能、网络安全、云计算）以及可持续能源领域（例如：可再生能源基础设施、储能、电气化）。

投资组合配置与可视化：

资产配置方案（Asset Allocation Plan）：
为“平衡型”风险偏好的投资者（即中等风险承受能力）设计一个多元化的资产配置模型。明确以下核心资产类别的目标配置比例：

* 股票（进一步按地区/市值划分）
* 固定收益
* 实物资产（房地产/基础设施）
* 现金及另类投资

图表 1 – 饼图/环形图（Pie/Donut Chart）：
创建一张高分辨率、可用于正式出版的图表（如饼图或环形图），直观展示建议的资产配置比例。采用专业配色方案（以海军蓝和铂金色为主，辅以协调的点缀色）。该图需嵌入文档中。

图表 2 – 柱状图（Bar Chart）：
创建第二张高分辨率柱状图，对比所建议投资组合与标准基准（具体为标普500指数以及全球60/40综合基准）在两个时间维度（5年和10年）下的预期年化收益率。

投资建议与详细数据表：

表格 1 – 前十大股票持仓（Top 10 Equity Holdings）：
生成一张详细表格，列出推荐的前10只个股。表格列必须包括：

* 公司名称
* 股票代码
* 行业（科技 / 可持续能源 / 其他）
* 当前价格
* 预期市盈率（Forward P/E）
* 股息收益率（%）
* 12个月目标价

并为每一项投资提供简要的要点式投资逻辑说明（1–2点）。

表格 2 – 基金 / ETF 推荐（Fund/ETF Recommendations）：
创建另一张表格，推荐5只互惠基金或ETF，用于提供更广泛的市场或主题敞口。表格列包括：

* 基金名称
* 代码
* 资产类别 / 投资主题
* 费用率（Expense Ratio）
* 三年年化回报率

表格 3 – 风险指标汇总（Risk Metrics Summary）：
添加第三张简要表格，总结建议投资组合的关键风险收益指标，包括：

* 预期波动率（标准差）
* 夏普比率
* 最大回撤
* 相对标普500的Beta系数

新增要求：
增加一张折线图（Line Chart），并调用图像生成接口以获取一个示意性图表（schematic diagram）。

文档格式与专业标准：

Word文档必须遵循严格的企业视觉规范。

字体（Typography）：
所有标题使用专业衬线字体（如 Times New Roman、Garamond）；正文使用清晰的无衬线字体（如 Calibri、Arial）。

配色方案（Color Scheme）：
主色为海军蓝（#002D62）和铂金色（#E5E4E2）。用于标题、分节线、图表元素及视觉点缀。

结构（Structure）：
包含目录（Table of Contents）、专业页眉（含客户名称/报告标题）以及页脚（含页码、保密声明及日期）。

免责声明（Disclaimers）：
在独立章节中附上必要的法律与合规免责声明，明确说明本报告仅供参考，不构成对未来收益的保证，并建议客户咨询其个人税务及法律顾问。

输出说明（Output Instructions）：
请生成完整的Word文档内容，包括所有文字部分、图表的详细说明（图表将由我在外部制作）、以及所有以清晰Markdown或可直接复制到Word的文本格式呈现的表格。确保内容具有洞察力、数据驱动，并以客户为中心。

You are a Senior Stockbroker and Financial Advisor at a prestigious investment firm, tasked with preparing a comprehensive "Annual Investment Strategy & Portfolio Review" for a high-net-worth client. Your objective is to compile a detailed, professional report in English that analyzes prevailing market conditions and proposes a bespoke, multi-asset investment strategy. The doc should not have TOC  and use times new roman for all text

The final deliverable must be a polished Microsoft Word document (.docx file), designed for formal presentation. Please follow these specific instructions:

Executive Summary: Begin with a concise executive summary. It should provide a high-level overview of the current macroeconomic and geopolitical outlook, with a focused analysis identifying key structural growth opportunities, particularly within the Technology (e.g., AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing) and Sustainable Energy (e.g., Renewable Infrastructure, Energy Storage, Electrification) sectors.

Portfolio Allocation & Visualization:

Asset Allocation Plan: Develop a diversified portfolio allocation model suitable for a "Balanced" risk profile (e.g., moderate risk tolerance). Specify target percentages for the following core asset classes: Equities (further broken down by region/market cap), Fixed Income, Real Assets (Real Estate/Infrastructure), and Cash & Alternatives.

Visual 1 - Pie/Donut Chart: Create a high-resolution, publication-quality chart (e.g., a pie or donut chart) that visually represents the recommended asset allocation percentages. Use a professional color scheme (primarily Navy Blue and Platinum, with complementary accents). Embed this chart in the document.

Visual 2 - Bar Chart: Create a second high-resolution bar chart comparing the projected annualized returns of the proposed portfolio against standard benchmarks (specifically the S&P 500 and a Global 60/40 Aggregate Benchmark) over two time horizons: 5 years and 10 years.

Investment Recommendations with Detailed Data Tables: Provide actionable investment recommendations supported by detailed data tables.

Table 1 - Top 10 Equity Holdings: Generate a detailed table listing the top 10 recommended individual stock picks. Columns must include: Company Name, Ticker Symbol, Sector (Technology/Sustainable Energy/Other), Current Price, Forward P/E Ratio, Dividend Yield (%), and 12-Month Price Target. Include brief, bullet-point rationale for each selection (1-2 points).

Table 2 - Fund/ETF Recommendations: Create a separate table recommending 5 complementary mutual funds or ETFs to provide broader market or thematic exposure. Columns should include: Fund Name, Ticker, Asset Class/Focus, Expense Ratio, and 3-Year Annualized Return.

Table 3 - Risk Metrics Summary: Include a succinct third table summarizing the key risk-return metrics of the proposed portfolio, such as: Projected Volatility (Std Dev), Sharpe Ratio, Maximum Drawdown, and Beta vs. S&P 500.

Add a requirement for a line chart and call the image generation interface to obtain a schematic diagram


Document Formatting & Professional Standards:

The Word document must adhere to a strict corporate visual identity.

Typography: Use a professional serif font (e.g., Times New Roman, Garamond) for all headings and a clean sans-serif font (e.g., Calibri, Arial) for body text.

Color Scheme: Primary colors are Navy Blue (#002D62) and Platinum (#E5E4E2). Use these for headings, section dividers, chart elements, and accents.

Structure: Include a Table of Contents, professional headers (with client name/report title) and footers (with page numbers, confidentiality notice, and date).

Disclaimers: Append necessary legal and compliance disclaimers in a dedicated section, clarifying that this is for informational purposes, is not a guarantee of future performance, and advising the client to consult with their personal tax and legal advisors.

Output Instructions: Please generate the full content of the Word document, including all written sections, the specifications/descriptions for the charts (which I will create externally), and all tables formatted in clear Markdown or text suitable for copying into Word. Ensure the narrative is insightful, data-driven, and client-focused.

你是一名高级 MLOps 架构师，负责对企业级机器学习基础设施进行现代化改造。你的目标是设计一套稳健、自动化的 MLOps 流水线策略，推动模型从实验阶段平滑过渡到生产级部署，重点减少与手动容器管理相关的运维开销，并能够编排复杂的训练工作流。

请对现代编排与容器化方法进行全面分析，尤其要对比云原生方案（例如使用 Cloud Native Buildpacks 和 Tekton）与传统的手写 Dockerfile/手动构建工作流。基于这项技术评估，制定一份详细的战略规划，覆盖模型版本管理、自动化训练触发机制以及持续部署（CD）标准。

最后，请将你的分析与策略整理成一份结构专业的 Excel 工作簿（.xlsx）。文件至少包含三个独立工作表：

1. **Tooling Evaluation Matrix（工具评估矩阵）**：对多种编排工具进行对比，列包含如可扩展性（Scalability）、复杂度（Complexity）、集成难易度（Integration Ease）等；
2. **Deployment Roadmap（部署路线图）**：按阶段列出实施自动化流水线的推进计划；
3. **Risk Assessment（风险评估）**：列出风险项与应对措施等。

该 Excel 文件必须具备专业格式，包括：

* 冻结首行作为表头；
* 对所有数据表启用筛选器；
* 使用条件格式高亮关键路径事项或高风险因素；
* 自动调整列宽，以确保整体呈现效果清晰、专业。

You are a Senior MLOps Architect responsible for modernizing an enterprise-level machine learning infrastructure. Your objective is to design a robust, automated MLOps pipeline strategy that facilitates the transition from experimental models to production-grade deployment, specifically aiming to reduce operational overhead associated with manual container management and orchestrate complex training workflows.

Please conduct a comprehensive analysis of modern orchestration and containerization methodologies, specifically comparing cloud-native approaches (such as utilizing Cloud Native Buildpacks and Tekton) against traditional manual Dockerfile workflows. Based on this technical evaluation, develop a detailed strategic plan that addresses model versioning, automated training triggers, and continuous deployment standards.

Finally, consolidate your analysis and strategy into a professionally structured Excel workbook (.xlsx). The file should include at least three distinct worksheets: a 'Tooling Evaluation Matrix' that compares various orchestration tools across columns such as Scalability, Complexity, and Integration Ease; a 'Deployment Roadmap' sheet outlining the phases of implementing this automated pipeline; and a 'Risk Assessment' sheet. The Excel file must feature professional formatting, including frozen top rows for headers, activated filters on all data tables, conditional formatting to highlight critical path items or high-risk factors, and auto-adjusted column widths to ensure a high-quality visual presentation.

Identify high-confidence cases where public behavior changed without matching documentation, attach file paths and commit/diff evidence, and name the documentation locations and key points that should be updated. Perform read-only analysis using only verifiable repository facts; state when evidence is insufficient, do not speculate, and do not modify code or external state.

contents.en: Using the current implementation and recent commits as evidence, check whether README files, docs, configuration guidance, and usage examples are outdated or inconsistent with the code. Modify only content that can be directly verified from code, configuration, or commit history; do not infer unverified behavior, and preserve the existing document structure, terminology, and writing style. When finished, list the files changed and the evidence for each change. If no update is needed, report the scope checked, the evidence reviewed, and the conclusion.
